description: Meteor is Shopware’s design system and documentation site for UI components, design tokens, icons, and usage guidelines. It also provides AI-friendly access to that documentation through an MCP server and machine-readable text files.
summary: meteor.shopware.com exposes one public MCP server at `https://meteor.shopware.com/mcp`; its llms.txt and raw markdown files are documentation artifacts, not separate integration surfaces.
